id: 1998-埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭
theater: 提格雷北部貝德梅山區

battle.name: 埃塞俄比亞-厄立特里亞戰爭
battle.theater: 提格雷北部貝德梅山區
battle.brief: 一九九八年五月到二〇〇〇年六月，埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞為貝德梅爭地全面開戰，逾五十萬兵力在三條戰線上以塹壕、坦克同空襲對峙。卡面這挺一八六〇年的加特林機槍靠六根管子分攤後坐力，它的原理並未退場：埃軍米格-21bis 與米-24 武裝直升機機首所裝的六管十二點七毫米加特林炮，正是它的直系後代。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰雙方是一九九三年才分開的兩個非洲國家。厄立特里亞一方是人民解放陣線執政的國家，總統伊薩亞斯·阿費韋基兼任武裝部隊最高指揮，軍事運作由塞巴特·埃普雷姆與奧格貝·阿布拉哈分掌，軍隊沿用獨立戰爭時期的蘇制體系，基幹是提格雷營與比沙里營，後方以深入埃塞俄比亞境內的地下網絡維持補給。埃塞俄比亞一方是聯邦民主共和國，由人民革命民主運動聯盟執政，總統梅萊斯·澤納維掌握最高決策，總參謀長察德坎·加布雷坦薩主持作戰，陸軍高級職位約八成由提格雷族軍官擔任，另有德威爾時期獲釋回隊的阿姆哈拉族軍官。厄方作戰單位以步兵營為核心，埃方以師為編制，戰前厄軍約四萬人、埃軍約十二萬人，一九九九年雙方各動員至二十五萬上下，二〇〇〇年五月埃軍投入四個裝甲師與二十二個步兵師的兵力亦有戰後記錄可查。聯合國、非盟同美國都曾提出撤軍方案斡旋，雙方卻都不接受對方畫出的地界線。戰時外國記者被嚴格限制在後方，多數戰況數字出自雙方各自發布的官方說法，難以交叉核對。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were African states that had only separated in 1993. Eritrea was ruled by the People's Liberation Front, with President Isaias Afewerki serving as the supreme commander and the war effort shared out between Sebhat Ephrem and Ogbe Abraha; its army kept the Soviet-derived system built during the War of Independence, with the Tigrayan and Bilali corps as the core, and it was sustained by underground networks operating deep inside Ethiopia. Ethiopia was the Federal Democratic Republic, governed by the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front under President Meles Zenawi, who held the final decision, with Chief of Staff Tsadkan Gebretensae running operations; Tigrayan officers still filled roughly 80 percent of the senior army posts, joined by Amhara officers who had returned to the colours after being released from prison in the Derg years. Eritrean tactical units were built around infantry battalions, Ethiopian units around divisions: before mobilisation Eritrea fielded about 40,000 troops and Ethiopia around 120,000, and by 1999 each side had mobilised close to 250,000 men, with post-war accounts also recording four armoured and twenty-two infantry divisions committed to the Ethiopian offensive of May 2000. The United Nations, the OAU and the United States all offered withdrawal plans to broker a settlement, and neither side accepted the line the other drew on the ground. Foreign correspondents were kept strictly behind the front for most of the war, so most of the figures that reached the public came from official statements issued by each government and could not be cross-checked.
people: 埃塞俄比亞方面，總統梅萊斯·澤納維是這場戰爭真正的決策者：他在軍隊處於劣勢時仍批准全面動員，又在二〇〇〇年五月攻佔厄方大片領土之後接受美方斡旋，把軍事成果轉成政治收場。總參謀長察德坎·加布雷坦薩主持二〇〇〇年五月十二日發動的聯合攻勢，四個裝甲師與二十二個步兵師同時投入。少將薩莫拉·尤尼斯一句話道出戰爭本質，他說厄利垂亞人擅長挖壕，而埃塞俄比亞人擅長把壕溝變成墳墓，雙方彼此都清楚。厄立特里亞方面，總統伊薩亞斯·阿費韋基在開戰前的判斷是要把貝德梅全境劃入己方，軍事層面則由塞巴特·埃普雷姆與奧格貝·阿布拉哈分頭負責。兩軍都大量徵召預備役與新兵：厄立特里亞參戰部隊約五分之一是女性，埃塞俄比亞則把大量未經充分訓練的新兵送上一線，軍事分析者指人海式衝鋒正是二〇〇〇年五月仍能突破塹壕的主因。雙方都設有專職收埋陣亡士兵的埋葬隊，埃塞俄比亞一側稱之為阿加拉伊。
peopleEn: On the Ethiopian side, President Meles Zenawi was the man who actually decided the war: he approved full mobilisation even while his army was on the back foot, and after the Ethiopian advance of May 2000 had taken large areas of Eritrean territory he accepted American mediation and turned the military gains into a political exit. Chief of Staff Tsadkan Gebretensae directed the combined offensive launched on May 12, 2000, in which four armoured and twenty-two infantry divisions were committed at once. Major General Samora Yunis summed up the character of the conflict in a single line, saying that the Eritreans were good at digging trenches and the Ethiopians were good at turning trenches into graves, and that both sides knew each other very well. On the Eritrean side, President Isaias Afewerki's judgement before the war was that Badme should be taken in full, with Sebhat Ephrem and Ogbe Abraha sharing out the military direction. Both armies called up reserves and new recruits on a large scale: about a fifth of the Eritrean troops in the fighting were women, while Ethiopia pushed large numbers of barely trained conscripts into the front line, and military analysts counted these mass infantry attacks as the main reason the trench line could still be broken in May 2000. Each side created dedicated burial units for its dead, and the Ethiopian service called them agalay.
kits: 卡面這件加特林機槍是一八六〇年的轉管速射兵器，靠人力踩動讓六根管子輪流發射，把後坐力分攤到六次上。一百三十多年後，它的原理並無退場，只是變成蘇製武器的標準配備：米格-21bis 與米-24 武裝直升機機首的六管十二點七毫米加特林機炮（YAK-B），正是同一種旋轉供彈設計。戰爭中埃塞俄比亞出動米-24V/35 武裝直升機，以火箭同機炮追擊撤退的厄軍，到二〇〇〇年五月為止至少損失兩架米-24；埃軍作戰飛機包括米格-21bis、米格-23BN、米格-29A 同蘇-25TK，厄軍則有米格-21bis、米格-23BN 同 MB-339 教練機，並以 ZSU-23 雙聯高射炮同 PKT 通用機槍構成低空攔截網。地面主戰裝備是蘇制 T-55 同 T-62 坦克，厄方有二百至三百輛（其中相當一部分不可用），埃方三百五十至四百輛，厄方稱在措索羅納一次戰鬥中摧毀四十五輛埃軍坦克。兩軍大量配備 PKM 通用機槍、AGS-17 自動榴彈發射器、迫擊炮同 122 毫米、152 毫米榴彈炮，厄方還用過蘇制反艦導彈 STYX。運輸方面，埃軍後勤因公路與油料不足大量倚賴驢馬馱運，厄軍則以卡車沿巴倫圖至門德法拉公路維持西線補給。
kitsEn: The piece on the card is an 1860 rotary cannon: the Gatling gun was cranked by hand so that six barrels fired in turn and the recoil was spread over six separate shots. More than a hundred and thirty years later the principle had not left the battlefield, it had simply become standard equipment on Soviet weapons: the six-barrel 12.7 mm Gatling cannon (YAK-B) in the nose of the MiG-21bis and of the Mi-24 helicopter is the same rotating-feed design. In the war Ethiopian Mi-24V/35 gunships used rockets and cannon fire to pursue retreating Eritrean troops, and at least two Mi-24s had been lost by May 2000; Ethiopian combat aircraft included the MiG-21bis, MiG-23BN, MiG-29A and Su-25TK, while Eritrea flew MiG-21bis and MiG-23BN fighters and MB-339 trainers and built a low-level interception screen out of ZSU-23 twin cannon and PKT machine guns. The main ground equipment on both sides was Soviet T-55 and T-62 tanks, with Eritrea holding 200 to 300, a good number of them unserviceable, against Ethiopia's 350 to 400, and Eritrea claimed to have destroyed forty-five Ethiopian tanks in the fighting at Tsorona. Both armies were saturated with PKM general-purpose machine guns, AGS-17 automatic grenade launchers, mortars and 122 mm and 152 mm howitzers, and Eritrea also used Soviet STYX anti-ship missiles. On the transport side, Ethiopian logistics leaned heavily on donkey and mule packs because roads and fuel were in short supply, while Eritrea ran trucks along the Barentu-Mendefera road to keep its western front supplied.
tactics: 戰術主調是第一次世界大戰式的塹壕對峙。三條戰線上，厄立特里亞倚靠海拔二千五百至三千公尺的山脊構築縱深碉堡、機槍巢同反坦克壕溝，埃塞俄比亞則以密集炮兵準備火力配合步兵波次衝鋒。地面進攻的標準程序是先用炮兵群覆蓋敵陣，再以整營步兵在坦克掩護下接近，最後才把冷卻下來的裝甲師投入佔領陣地。一九九九年二月二十二日的日落行動是典型案例：先以四架戰機空襲阿薩布機場，再以大規模炮擊吸引厄軍注意，三個師在比尤昆迪突破後直趨杜坎比亞，隨即折向北面側擊貝德梅以北的厄軍師，迫其放棄近百公里塹壕與大部分重武器。二〇〇〇年五月十二日，埃軍在尚布科與門德法拉之間突破，渡過馬雷布河，切斷巴倫圖至門德法拉公路，使西線厄軍失去主要補給線，再以三個山地步兵營翻越山脊直取扎拉姆貝薩。空軍方面雙方都以武裝直升機與戰機配合地面突擊，埃軍還在二〇〇〇年五月二十九日以空襲施壓談判。防守的要點是第二線陣地上的反擊與縱深火力，ZSU-23 同通用機槍把攻擊者釘在雷區之前。一九九八年六月的雨季令平時乾涸的貝德梅河床泛水，大幅拖慢厄軍後勤，可見這場戰爭比拼的是道路同水源，而非機動作戰。
tacticsEn: The dominant tactical pattern was the trench standoff of the First World War. On the three fronts the Eritreans built deep positions of pillboxes, machine-gun nests and anti-tank ditches along ridges between 2,500 and 3,000 metres above sea level, and the Ethiopians answered with massed artillery preparation followed by infantry waves. The standard sequence for a ground attack was to saturate the enemy position with guns, advance with whole battalions under cover of tanks, and only then bring forward the armoured units that had been held in reserve. Operation Sunset of February 22, 1999 was the textbook case: four fighters first struck Assab airport, a heavy barrage drew Eritrean attention to Tsorona, three divisions broke through at Biyukundi and pushed for Dukambiya, and they then turned north to strike the flank of the Eritrean division north of Badme, forcing it to abandon close to a hundred kilometres of trench and most of its heavy weapons. On May 12, 2000 the Ethiopians broke through between Shambuko and Mendefera, crossed the Mareb River and cut the Barentu-Mendefera road that fed the western front, then sent three mountain infantry battalions over the ridges to take Zalambessa. On the air side both armies used armed helicopters and fighters in support of ground attacks, and the Ethiopians bombed Eritrean cities on May 29, 2000 to put pressure on the talks. The key to the defence was the counterattack from prepared second-line positions, where ZSU-23 guns and general-purpose machine guns pinned the attackers in front of the minefields. The rainy season of June 1998 turned the normally dry Badme riverbed into water and slowed Eritrean supply lines badly, which shows how far the campaign turned on roads and water rather than on manoeuvre.
data: 可核對的數字大致落在幾個區間。戰前厄立特里亞常備軍約四萬人，埃塞俄比亞約十二萬人；坦克方面厄方有二百至三百輛，其中相當一部分不可用，埃方三百五十至四百輛。開戰後雙方各動員至二十五萬上下，總參戰兵力超過五十萬，普遍被視為當時非洲規模最大的戰爭。陣亡數字說法不一：厄方稱己方陣亡一萬九千至五萬人、被俘約二千六百人；埃方稱己方陣亡三萬四千至六萬人、被俘約一千一百人；國際危機組織的估計是雙方合計七萬至十萬人陣亡。全程歷時約二十五個月，一九九八年五月六日開火，二〇〇〇年六月十八日達成停火框架，十二月十二日簽署和平協定。距離數字亦有記錄：一九九九年日落行動五天之內推進約十公里，厄軍放棄近百公里塹壕；二〇〇〇年五月二十三日埃軍宣稱奪取中部扎拉姆貝薩的厄軍指揮部，該地距阿斯馬拉約一百公里；五月十六日至十七日的戰線縱深由阿勒扎、梅德馬延伸到巴倫圖一線。空軍損失方面，厄方記錄有四架米格-29A 與一架 MB-339CE，埃方記錄有三架米格-21bis、一架米格-23BN、一架蘇-25TK 同至少兩架米-24 被擊落，厄方另稱在措索羅納摧毀四十五輛埃軍坦克。戰後埃塞俄比亞的復員退役計畫覆蓋逾十四萬八千名退役軍人，總花費一億七千四百萬美元，其中一億七千萬來自世界銀行貸款。
dataEn: The verifiable figures fall into a few ranges. Before the war Eritrea had about 40,000 troops on strength and Ethiopia around 120,000; in tanks Eritrea held 200 to 300, a good number of them unserviceable, against Ethiopia's 350 to 400. Both sides then mobilised close to 250,000 men, putting more than half a million troops in the field, and the war was widely described as the largest in Africa at the time. Loss figures remain disputed: Eritrea claimed 19,000 to 50,000 of its own dead and about 2,600 prisoners; Ethiopia claimed 34,000 to 60,000 of its own dead and about 1,100 prisoners; the International Crisis Group put the combined death toll at 70,000 to 100,000. The war ran for about twenty-five months, from the first shots on May 6, 1998 to the ceasefire framework of June 18, 2000 and the peace agreement signed on December 12. Distances are on record as well: in five days the February 1999 offensive advanced about ten kilometres and the Eritreans abandoned nearly a hundred kilometres of trench; on May 23, 2000 the Ethiopians said they had seized the Eritrean command post at Zalambessa, about a hundred kilometres south of Asmara; the front on May 16-17 ran from Areza through Maidema to Barentu. On the air side Eritrea is credited with the loss of four MiG-29As and one MB-339CE, and Ethiopia with three MiG-21bis, one MiG-23BN, one Su-25TK and at least two Mi-24s, while Eritrea claimed forty-five Ethiopian tanks destroyed at Tsorona. Ethiopia's disarmament, demobilisation and reintegration programme afterwards covered more than 148,000 demobilised soldiers at a cost of 174 million dollars, of which 170 million came from a World Bank loan.
cause: 導火索是邊界。1962年聯合國大會第2314號決議成立的帝國邊界委員會在劃定埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞邊界時，約一百公里地段的界線未能確定，成為雙方各執一端的灰色地帶，而貝德梅村正好落在這條線上。厄立特里亞在一九九三年獨立後雙方關係一度尚可，但厄方逐步把貝德梅全境視為己方領土，並在邊境多次騷擾。一九九八年五月六日，厄方一支機械化部隊進入貝德梅地區，與當地民兵及警察交火；五月十二日凌晨至少兩個旅在坦克與火炮支援下進攻貝德梅及周邊多個行政區，次日占領貝德梅平原與埃方東部高地，埃方守軍主力其實是民兵與警察。厄方稱此前有武裝事件造成厄方官員被殺，埃方則指控厄方侵入並占領爭議區，雙方說法至今互斥。五月十三日埃塞俄比亞議會宣布對厄立特里亞開展總體戰，全國動員。深層原因還包括一九九一年起厄方把境內埃塞俄比亞人強制遷出的政策、兩國在貨幣、關稅與產業政策上的分歧，以及埃方領導層擔心失去對提格雷地區的掌控；事後的研究者指出，貝德梅本身幾無戰略與經濟價值，其象徵意義才是戰爭真正的燃料。
causeEn: The trigger was the border. When the Imperial Boundary Commission set up under United Nations General Assembly resolution 2314 of 1962 delimited the frontier between Ethiopia and Eritrea, roughly a hundred kilometres of it was never actually fixed, leaving a grey zone that each side claimed in full, and the village of Badme sat on that line. Relations were still workable for a while after Eritrean independence in 1993, but Eritrea came to treat the whole of Badme as its own territory and harassed the border repeatedly. On May 6, 1998 an Eritrean mechanised force entered the Badme area and clashed with local militia and police; in the early hours of May 12 at least two brigades attacked Badme and several districts of Tahtay and La'ilay Adiyabo with tank and gun support, and the next day they took the Badme plain and the Ethiopian highlands above it, the Ethiopian defenders there being mainly militia and police. Eritrea said that armed incidents in which Eritrean officials were killed had preceded this; Ethiopia accused Eritrea of invading and occupying the disputed zone, and the two accounts have never been reconciled. On May 13 the Ethiopian parliament declared a war of total mobilisation against Eritrea. The deeper causes include the expulsion of Ethiopians from Eritrean territory that began in 1991, the divergence between the two countries over currency, tariffs and industrial policy, and Ethiopian fears of losing control of the Tigray region. Researchers writing after the war argued that Badme had no real strategic or economic value and that its symbolic weight was the true fuel of the conflict.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了兩國的軍隊與國家結構。埃塞俄比亞為十四萬八千名以上退役軍人推行長達六年的復員、退役與再融入計畫，總開支一億七千四百萬美元，本國財政只能支付三百一十萬，其餘靠世界銀行一億七千萬美元的貸款；厄立特里亞則在國庫空虛下向海外僑民發放戰時公債募資。武器禁運在二〇〇〇年五月十七日經安理會第1298號決議對兩國實施，其後僅對埃塞俄比亞解除，以便其參與索馬里方向的行動。戰後的判定把貝德梅判給厄立特里亞：二〇〇二年四月十四日成立的邊界委員會作出最終且有約束力的裁決，貝德梅歸厄方，多數爭議地帶歸埃方，兩國邊界衝突就此延續近二十年，形成不開戰、也不簽和約的局面，其間邊境小規模衝突與軍備競賽持續，直到二〇一八年兩國宣布和平、二〇二〇年提格雷戰爭之後才告一段落。埃塞俄比亞的勝利並未帶來安寧，軍隊在此後十多年仍以邊境部署與國內整編為主；厄立特里亞則長期處在國際孤立與制裁壓力之下。學界普遍視這場戰爭為非洲冷戰末期規模最大的常規戰之一，其經驗直接推動了聯合國其後在非洲的維和部署模式。
impactEn: The war reshaped the armed forces and the state structures of both countries. Ethiopia ran a six-year disarmament, demobilisation and reintegration programme for more than 148,000 demobilised soldiers at a cost of 174 million dollars, of which the government itself could pay only 3.1 million and the rest came from a 170 million dollar World Bank loan; Eritrea, with an empty treasury, issued war bonds to its diaspora to pay for the fighting. An arms embargo was imposed on both countries by Security Council resolution 1298 of May 17, 2000, and was later lifted for Ethiopia alone so that it could take part in operations in Somalia. The postwar ruling went against Ethiopia: on April 14, 2002 the Boundary Commission established under the Algiers Agreement handed Badme to Eritrea and most of the disputed ground to Ethiopia, and the border conflict then ran for nearly two decades as a situation of no war and no peace, with recurring small clashes and an arms race along the line until the two states declared peace in 2018 and the Tigray war of 2020 finally closed the chapter. Ethiopia's victory brought no peace: its army spent the following decade on border deployments and domestic reorganisation, while Eritrea remained under international isolation and sanctions pressure. Scholars generally treat the conflict as one of the largest conventional wars of the late Cold War in Africa, and its lessons fed directly into the peacekeeping model the United Nations later applied on the continent.
result: 結果是埃塞俄比亞在戰場上獲勝，卻沒有拿到戰爭所要的東西。埃軍在二〇〇〇年五月攻佔厄方約四分之一國土，切斷中部與西部補給線，厄軍西線約八個師被擊潰、其餘七個師重創；五月十六日至二十四日，埃軍在尚布科至門德法拉一線突破並奪取巴倫圖與阿勒扎，五月二十五日宣布戰爭結束。三十日埃軍仍以空襲施壓談判，厄方則把撤出佔地說成是恢復談判的善意姿態，實則是全線崩潰之後的退卻。六月十八日雙方在美國斡旋下達成阿爾及爾協議，同意全面停火並把邊界爭議交由有約束力的仲裁處理；七月三十一日安理會第1312號決議設立二十五公里寬的臨時安全區，由來自六十多個國家的聯合國埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞特派團巡邏；十二月十二日兩國簽署和平協定，十二月下旬起交換戰俘。戰後的仲裁把貝德梅判給厄立特里亞，等於說這場戰爭在戰術上失敗，在外交上同樣失敗。埃塞俄比亞承認代價巨大，卻也憑此役鞏固了提格雷人主導的軍隊與聯邦政府的正當性；厄立特里亞失去了貝德梅以外的全部戰果，換來的是邊界地位在法律上的確認，以及隨後二十年不開戰也不簽和約的不確定狀態。
resultEn: The outcome was an Ethiopian victory on the battlefield and the absence of the result the war was fought for. By May 2000 the Ethiopian army held roughly a quarter of Eritrean territory, had cut the supply lines in the central and western sectors, and had routed about eight Eritrean divisions on the western front while badly mauling another seven; between May 16 and 24 the Ethiopians broke through on the Shambuko-Mendefera axis, took Barentu and Areza, and on the 25th declared the war over. On the 30th the Ethiopian air force was still bombing to force the pace of the talks, while Eritrea described its withdrawal from occupied ground as a goodwill gesture to revive the talks, in practice the retreat of an army that had collapsed along the whole line. On June 18 the two sides reached the Algiers Agreement under American mediation, accepting a full ceasefire and referring the border dispute to binding arbitration; on July 31 Security Council resolution 1312 created a twenty-five-kilometre Temporary Security Zone patrolled by the United Nations Mission in Ethiopia and Eritrea drawn from more than sixty countries, and on December 12 the two governments signed the peace agreement, exchanging prisoners from late December. The Algiers arbitration then awarded Badme to Eritrea, so the war was a tactical defeat and a diplomatic defeat as well. Ethiopia accepted that the war had cost it dearly, yet the campaign consolidated the standing of a Tigrayan-led army and of the federal government; Eritrea kept none of the gains outside Badme, but gained legal confirmation of its frontier and two decades of unstable no-war-no-peace afterwards.
